events.comment: Hub gates: the boss gates open one at a time (Order). Walk up to the next one and press F to awaken it (a short camera move shows it waking); F at an awakened gate enters it. A beaten boss's gate shows its completed art. Back from a win, the player starts at that gate, and a newly beaten boss's gate plays a defeat cutscene (with a low gong it cuts to its completed art). Progress is saved in local storage; F10 wipes it (debug).

//   ready     - the next gate in order, not awakened yet: inert art, a faint glow, "[F] Awaken - <Label>".
//   active    - awakened: the gate's live loop, "[F] <Label>" enters.
//   completed - its boss is beaten: the completed art, still enterable for a rematch.

// with a shake, holds, and the camera glides back. F or Esc skips it.

events.comment: Hub crow: two crows live on each torii gate, never closer than a set gap. They perch, hop along the beam, vanish and reappear as dust, and one caws roughly every 15 s.

inlineCode: // The torii crow, as the gates pack's HANDOFF.md describes it. Generated by tools/hub/build.js: edit tools/hub/hub.js and rebuild.
// Each torii gets two crows, drawn between the torii's back (portal, gate, lanterns) and front (spirits, petals).
// Cycle: appear (dust gathers) -> idle on a perch (15-40 s; every 4-10 s it hops 1-3 times along the beam) ->
// vanish (dusts away) -> gone (6-15 s) -> appear again at a random perch, facing a random way.
// The two crows on a torii keep C.gap px apart: a crow only appears on a perch that far from the other, and turns
// round rather than hop closer. Roughly every 15 s a perched crow caws (quieter the further the player is).
// The animations' origins are the feet anchors, so the crow's X/Y is where its feet are: gate X/Y + perch * gate scale.
const st = runtimeScene.__hubCrows || (runtimeScene.__hubCrows = { birds: null, nextCaw: 5 + Math.random() * 5, cawer: null });
const rnd = function (r) { return r[0] + Math.random() * (r[1] - r[0]); };
const perchAt = function (px) { const i = C.perchX.indexOf(px); return i < 0 ? null : C.perchY[i]; };
// Is perch px far enough from every other crow on the same torii (where it stands, and where it is hopping to)?
if (o.mode === "hop" && Math.abs(px - o.to) < C.gap) return false;
flock.push({ o: o, t: t, mode: "gone", timer: rnd(C.firstAppear[Math.min(k, C.firstAppear.length - 1)]), px: 0, dir: 1 });
for (const b of flock) { b.mates = flock.filter(function (x) { return x !== b; }); st.birds.push(b); }
// Caw timer: roughly every C.caw.every seconds, one perched crow (not about to leave) is picked to caw this frame.
// With none perched the timer waits, and the next crow to settle is picked.
const ready = st.birds.filter(function (b) { return b.mode === "idle" && b.stay > 1.5; });
if (ready.length) { st.cawer = ready[Math.floor(Math.random() * ready.length)]; st.nextCaw = rnd(C.caw.every); }
// Plays a random caw clip and returns how long to hold the caw pose.
const i = Math.floor(Math.random() * CAW.files.length), pitch = 0.94 + Math.random() * 0.12;
return CAW.hold[i] / pitch; // A higher pitch plays faster.
const t = b.t, o = b.o, scale = t.getWidth() / 128;
const place = function (px, py) { o.setX(t.getX() + px * scale); o.setY(t.getY() + py * scale); };
const free = C.perchX.filter(function (px) { return clear(b, px); });
if (!free.length) b.timer = 2; // No room next to the other crow: try again shortly.
b.mode = "idle"; b.stay = rnd(C.stay); b.timer = rnd(C.hopEvery); b.hopsLeft = 0; play("idle");
if (st.cawer === b) { b.mode = "caw"; b.cawLeft = caw(b); play("caw"); }
// End of a beam, or the other crow is in the way: turn round.
if (perchAt(to) === null || !clear(b, to)) { b.dir = -b.dir; play("idle"); b.timer = rnd([0.8, 2]); b.hopsLeft = 0; }
else { b.mode = "hop"; b.from = b.px; b.to = to; b.hopT = 0; play("hop"); }
// The hop animation carries the bird 10 px; the feet stay on the start perch's X while the Y follows the beam's curve.
// Holds the caw pose (neck out, beak open) while the clip's two caws sound, then back to idle.
if (b.mode === "idle" || b.mode === "caw" || b.mode === "vanish" || b.mode === "appear") place(b.px, perchAt(b.px));
